messages:
Aisha (CS): Drafting a short customer-facing runbook for low-touch accounts — goal: keep warm pools small, use staggered prefill, capture renewal signals early without too much cost. Sharing a compact flow below, pls review.

Ben (SRE): Love it. Two quick ops rules: 1) per-tenant prefill TTL = 10m default with exponential backoff; 2) add jitter +/- 20% to avoid thundering herd. Example config:
```
{"prefill_ttl":600, "backoff_ms":500, "jitter_pct":20}
```

Marco (PM): Nice. Add KPIs: activation within 72h, 5-day retention, prefill hit rate, avg token cost per activation. Also note fallback model for degraded capacity.

Aisha (CS): Agree. Also recommend lightweight telemetry hooks for renewal signals: send a weekly digest of top 5 customers with drop in prompt success rate or >10% spike in latencies.

Jia (Customer): Quick question — for small accounts, does prefill cost get charged? We want to pass expectations to customers.

Aisha (CS): Prefill is included in our usage but we suggest configuring conservative batch sizes for free-tier trials. We'll put the recommended presets in the runbook.

Ben (SRE): Operational checklist (short):
- ensure KV cache enabled
- monitor prefill hit rate
- set alert: tenant prefill error rate > 5% for 10m
- fallback route: model-lite

OnboardingBot: New draft added to /playbooks/customer-short-runbooks — 1810001111

Marco (PM): UX snippet for customers (one-line): "Enable recommended prefill to reduce first-response latency. Toggle defaults are safe and cost-conscious." :thumbsup:

Aisha (CS): I'll fold this into a one-pager with sections: Overview, Quick Setup (3 toggles), Ops guardrails, Renewal signals, Troubleshooting. Anyone want to add a short troubleshooting Q/A?

Ben (SRE): Add Q: "Why is prefill not hitting?" Answer: check TTL mismatch, KV eviction, and batching config. Add sample debug command: `curl -H "X-Tenant"... /metrics/prefill`.

Jia (Customer): This looks great. Request: add an example email template to reach out when early renewal signal triggers.

Aisha (CS): Will add. Plan: final draft by EOD Fri, then handoff to growth for email templates. Thanks all :heart:
